Clara Tabody
Clara Tabody( 1915–1986) was a Hungarian actress, singer and dancer. She starred in both the stage version of the operetta" Mask in Blue" and its 1943 film adaptation. She worked for many years in Germany where at one point the studio Tobis Film briefly tried to build her up as a rival to her fellow Hungarian Marika Rökk, then working for UFA. After marrying an Italian she principally settled in that country. Her sister Ida Turay was also an actress, knowng for her starring roles in Hungarian films.
